name: @ai-ecoverse/gcloud
description: The gcloud-ext CLI for jsh: per-service and per-SKU Google Cloud cost and usage from a logged-in Cloud Console tab, which the real gcloud CLI cannot report. Everything else in the skill uses Google's own gcloud and bq from @ai-ecoverse/gcloud-cli. `pnpm add` it in /opt/user on SLICC 7, or `npm install -g` this folder to put `gcloud-ext` on PATH.
